# awscc_ec2_instance_event_window (Resource)

Resource type definition for AWS::EC2::InstanceEventWindow. An event window defines a recurring set of time ranges, or a cron expression, during which AWS-initiated maintenance events may be scheduled for the associated Amazon EC2 instances or Dedicated Hosts.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cron_expression` (String) The cron expression defined for the event window. Exactly one of TimeRanges or CronExpression must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the event window.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags applied to the event window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `time_ranges` (Attributes List) The time ranges of the event window. Exactly one of TimeRanges or CronExpression must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_ranges))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the event window.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `instance_event_window_id` (String) The ID of the event window.
- `state` (String) The current state of the event window. Observed values include creating, active, modifying, deleting and deleted.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--time_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_ranges`

Optional:

- `end_hour` (Number) The hour when the time range ends.
- `end_week_day` (String) The day on which the time range ends.
- `start_hour` (Number) The hour when the time range begins.
- `start_week_day` (String) The day on which the time range begins.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_instance_event_window.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the event window

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_instance_event_window.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ec2_instance_event_window.example "arn"
```
